device.modelDescription: Step module of the ch-packs family: suggests who might know about a CI failure, as GitHub logins only, never e-mail addresses or display names. A suggestion, never an action. A pure function of its input: no disk, no network, no state.

actionList.name: hint
actionList.description: Takes the commit where a failure first appeared and the recent commits before it, each with its author's GitHub login or null, and returns at most three logins: the first-seen commit's author first, then the recent changes' authors in the order given, each once, with one sentence per login saying why it is there. Refuses anything that is not a GitHub login (an e-mail address, a display name), so none can pass through.
